'''R5-TK''' was a salvaged [[R5-series astromech droid]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] specialized in acquiring [[Targeting computer/Legends|target locks]] on other ships during space combat.
